source_record.title: Working Student Finance (all genders)
source_record.description:
Your challenge

Are you looking to bridge the gap between your studies and the professional world? At Hubject, we are looking for a motivated Working Student in Finance (all genders) to support our team. You will gain hands-on experience in everything from day-to-day accounting and invoice verification to the complexities of monthly and annual closings. This is your chance to apply your analytical skills in a real-world setting, master ERP systems, and help us optimize our financial processes. If you’re a numbers-driven student with a structured mindset, we want to hear from you!


Why Hubject

We develop ideas and deliver solutions for the eMobility market
We are working on the most important growth topics
We are an international team of very motivated eMobility enthusiasts

AND

We have over 30 benefits different categories:

  • Food & Drinks (6 € food subsidy on your daily lunch up to 90 € per month)

  • Mobility* (58 € monthly public transport subsidy)

  • Health & sports* (Urban sports membership M)

  • Equipment (Laptop etc)

  • Learning and development (yearly training budget and Udemy learning platform access)

  • Hubject Lifestyle (Voiio membership)

  • Family-friendly environment (flex working time)

  • Employee Discounts via Corporate Benefits program Probonio

    *Please note that you get to choose one option between the Mobility and Health & Sport benefit 


Your Tasks

  • Support with invoice verification and preparation
  • Assist in monthly and annual closing processes
  • Maintain and analyze financial data in our systems
  • Support budget planning and forecasting
  • Prepare reports and presentations for management
  • Contribute to process optimization in finance


Your Profile

  • Enrolled student in the final Bachelor semester or Master’s program (Business Administration, Finance, Accounting or similar)
  • Basic knowledge of accounting or controlling is a plus
  • Proficient in MS Excel, ideally with ERP system experience
  • Analytical and structured working style


Language

  • Good command of English, German is a plus


Start date

As soon as possible


Location

Onsite in Berlin

Hybrid system with at least one office day per week


@ EUREF Campus in Schöneberg in Berlin - Europe's hotspot for green technology and eMobility
